item.title: Supreme Court Strikes Down Trump's Tariffs
item.description: In dissent, Justice Brett Kavanaugh wrote, "The tariffs at issue here may or may not be wise policy. But as a matter of text, history, and precedent, they are clearly lawful."

item.title: The Supreme Court's Tariff Ruling Was Constitutionally Correct
item.description: Even if you support President Donald Trump's tariffs and strategy, six of the Court's justices came to the right conclusion.

item.title: The Tariffs Are Dead, Long Live the Tariffs
item.description: The Supreme Court may have struck down President Trump's tariffs on Friday, but hours later, he had reimplemented them under other authority.

item.title: Tucker Beclowns Himself in 'Detention'

item.title: Team USA Delivers
item.description: While other American athletes seemed somewhat lukewarm about representing their country in the Winter Olympics, there was no lack of patriotism among our hockey players.
